rows.en: …!? You!? Who are you?

Dasmader!

At this rate, General Jark is at a disadvantage! Send reinforcements!!

He'll be fighting the Kamen Riders with all his abilities!

If he should lose, then we'll have no further use for him!

How heartless…!

General Jark! Let me lend you what little strength I have…
You will not…!
Enemy reinforcements!?
Enemy reinforcements!?
Enemy reinforcements!?
That's cowardly, Jark Midora!
Nu, nuoooh…!!
If that's how you want it…
We'll join the fight too!
Nuooooh…

Uuugh…

Well done, defeating me! But remember this! No matter how many of you there are, you can never beat the Crisis Emperor…!

Heh heh heh… Ha ha ha!
Heh heh heh… Don't think for a moment that this means you've won!
That voice…!?
Just as you fight to protect the peace of Earth… I too have fought for our five billion people!
All your many evil schemes on Earth… We can't let them stand!!
All your many evil schemes on Earth… We can't let them stand!!
That is something you filthy humans have brought about with your own hands!
What!? What's that supposed to mean?
You'll understand when you see the true face of the Kaima World!
Its true face?
Our Kaima World has already merged with the dimensional distortion field!! You can see it too, can't you?
That planet is…!?
That planet is our homeland, Kaima Space! Take a good look!

…!?

Impossible! That's the Japanese archipelago…!? Why!? Why is the Japanese archipelago on that planet?

Our homeland, the Kaima World, is the shadow of Earth! No, you might even call it Earth's twin…

Our Kaima World has survived for a long time by keeping a balance with Earth…

Truly… you could say we have shared the same fate.

But now that balance has collapsed! You humans grew arrogant and destroyed Earth's environment…

And all the consequences of that came crashing down on the Kaima World! Earth's pollutants have completely smothered the Kaima World.
Wait! The Kaima World declined because of the Crisis Emperor's tyrannical policies!

Silence!

The greatest cause of all… was the environmental destruction by you foolish Earthlings!

The Kaima World is rushing toward collapse!

Can you Earthlings really object to our moving to Earth with our five billion people!?

It's true… we may share some of the blame.

Trash carelessly thrown away on the street gets washed by the rain into the rivers. And eventually it drifts out to sea and ends up in the mouths of fish…

The fish that swallow the trash can't digest it, and in the end they die…

Maybe it's actually us who are destroying the environment and killing living things.

It's true… we're partly to blame too.

Trash people just toss on the street gets washed by the rain into the rivers. And then it drifts out to sea and ends up in fishes' mouths, right…

The fish that swallow the trash can't digest it, and in the end they just die…

Maybe it really is us who are wrecking the environment and killing living things.

…!?

So you were the Crisis Emperor all along!?

That is correct…

But this is where we part ways! If we were to rampage here… we too would become animals no different from you filthy humans.

Do you still not understand!?

If you humans pollute the Earth, a new Kaima World will be born and attack the Earth! All of it is the sin of you humans…

We, the five billion, need make no further sacrifices to teach you humans a lesson.

Our Crisis Empire shall reign under Steel Emperor Zephas until the day we rebuild our strength…

Steel Emperor Zephas shall become the all-knowing, all-powerful savior of the entire universe… Who is truly evil? Agonize over it!

Ha ha ha…

Wait!!

No matter what anyone says, we will fight!! We'll fight to protect humanity's freedom and peace.
That's right! That is our mission…
A chronicle of justice that will be handed down forever!
That's what the eternal Riders are!
We won't lose! Not until the day we seize true freedom and peace…
Kamen Rider BLACK defeated General Jark! And the Crisis Emperor, leaving behind words of bitter resentment, vanished into the darkness of the Kaima World…
But the threat of the Kaima World has not completely disappeared! Fight with all your strength to protect Earth from evil!
Kamen Rider BLACK RX defeated General Jark! And the Crisis Emperor, leaving behind words of bitter resentment, vanished into the darkness of the Kaima World…
But the threat of the Kaima World has not completely disappeared! RX! Fight with all your strength to protect Earth from evil!
The invaders from outer space who command Gigant and Kelbaan, the Space Fortress Naager, have finally revealed themselves and declared war on humanity!
Naager descended upon the Aokigahara forest at the foot of Mt. Fuji in Japan… It burned the whole area to the ground, turned its hull into a fortress, and created a hellish battlefield!
Now, the battle between humanity and Naager begins!
Uoh… Kuh…
Waaagh…
What…!? Kuh…
Damn… Am I going to be beaten in a place like this!?
Kyaa…
Whoa whoa… Uuugh…

Waagh…

Damn! I can't lose in a place like this… I can't lose… Uuugh…
Defeat all Chap Soldiers!
Defeat Strongest Kaima Beastman Granzairus!
Defeat the strongest monster Jark Midora and all Chap Soldiers!
Any ally is defeated
Emperor Guillotine… I have brought the doctor, as promised.

Oh, Space Monster Doctor Gelma! Welcome, from the far reaches of the Fourth-Dimension Nebula…

Doctor… I want you to bring Giant Robo back into our hands!
Rest assured, Emperor… With my power, I shall obtain Giant Robo without fail.
Heh heh heh… Our Naager will also lend what help we can.
Emperor Guillotine… Place your trust in the power of the Space Monster Doctor! Heh heh heh heh heh…

Happy Birthday to You, Happy Birthday, Dear Daisaku…

Happy Birthday to You!
Congratulations, Daisaku.
"Happy Birthday", huh…
Oh? Takeshi, I guess since you've been abroad, you, uh… know what it means?

Huh…?

Don't tell me… Oyassan, you were singing it without knowing what the English meant?
Well, what do you expect… the only English I know is "amigo"!
Hee hee… "Amigo" is Spanish! And by the way, it means "friend".

That's our Marie, eh?

So "amigo" means "friend"… Hmm, we've got pretty good taste, if I do say so myself! Right?
I can't believe it, but… Oyassan… looks like you only just realized that?
Why, you little…

…Hm?

Oh, sorry. We're not open to regular customers today…
Ah… no, it's a delivery! Is there a Daisaku… Kusama here? Please sign for this.

Yes… Thanks!

Ah! It's from Dad!
What could it be? That's a pretty big package, huh?
My father's on a business trip in Hokkaido, and he sent it to me.

U07798/U07799: [HERO2] lines say 許すわけにはいかん; rendered with "We" (the heroes collectively); could be "I".
U07806: 怪魔空間 here vs 怪魔界 elsewhere; rendered "Kaima Space" to keep the difference.
U07815: 様牲を振るって read as 犠牲を払って; 50嬉の民 as "the five billion".
U07838: [ja] read as 味方がひとりでも ("Any ally is defeated").
U07848/U07852: Goro and Kotaro address Tachibana as "Oyassan" per glossary (おやっさん written in source).
U07851: マリーちゃん rendered "our Marie".
U07853/U07854: narration-kind row continues Tachibana's line (interrupted by the delivery man).

new_names.en: Aokigahara forest at the foot of Mt. Fuji
